title: Lentil Bolognese
description: This vegan lentil Bolognese is made with green lentils, meaty mushrooms, garlic, tomatoes, and mixed herbs for a flavorsome vegetarian sauce for pasta.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil, or to taste
2 cloves garlic, crushed and finely chopped
1 teaspoon ground paprika, or more to taste
1 teaspoon dried basil, or more to taste
1 teaspoon dried oregano, or more to taste
1 teaspoon mixed dried herbs, or to taste

steps.text: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion and garlic; sauté until soft, about 5 minutes. Stir in bell pepper and carrot; cook for 4 to 5 minutes. Add mushrooms; cook and stir until softened, about 2 minutes.

Pour in wine and simmer until slightly reduced, about 1 minute. Stir in diced tomatoes and vegetable broth. Bring sauce to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer until flavors combine, 10 to 15 minutes. Stir in lentils, paprika, basil, oregano, mixed herbs, and nutmeg; cook until lentils are heated through, about 5 minutes.

video.description: Lentils, red wine, nutmeg, and tomatoes blend perfectly in this Bolognese rendition of a classic sauce. Wine and broth, with fresh herbs like basil and oregano pair beautifully with simmering onion, garlic, and mushrooms. Place sauce atop your favorite noodles and you’ll have a filling and delicious Italian-inspired meal.
